home.hero_desc_1: Our farm started its journey in 2019 in West Surabaya under the name 4 Putra Parrot. Initially, we focused on breeding Lovebirds. However, as our experience grew and our understanding of parrot characteristics deepened, we confidently expanded into breeding various parrot species.
home.hero_desc_2: We maintained this consistency until we successfully developed large parrots such as the Blue & Gold Macaw and other Macaw variants.
home.hero_desc_3: In 2025, we changed our breeding business name to PT 4 Putra Vertex Aviary. This change signifies our seriousness in legally breeding parrots.
home.popular_desc: Discover our favorite parrot collections, from the agile Sun Conure to the majestic Macaw, all captive-bred, tame, and ready to be your new companion.
footer.slogan: Making every customer feel valued - no matter the size of your audience
achievements.hero_welcome: EXHIBITION AND EDUCATION ON CURVED-BILLED BIRDS AT
achievements.hero_desc_1: 4Putra Vertex Aviary had the opportunity to hold an educational exhibition at Dinamika University. It was not just a visual exhibition; we presented an interactive experience where students could interact directly with our exotic collection, from cheerful Galah to majestic Macaws.
achievements.hero_desc_2: This activity is a tangible manifestation of our commitment to not only be breeders, but also educators. We share insights about the unique characteristics of curved-beak birds, the importance of animal welfare, and the legality of keeping exotic animals in Indonesia.
